mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: Every feature of a desert camel is a desert adaptation.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: Fish acquire streamlined bodies because they move easily through water.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: Hot- and cold-desert camels need exactly the same adaptations.

mx.name: surface_feature_capture
mx.teacher_note: Ordinary-looking sloping branches on a mountain tree are not an adaptation.

intelligence.enrichment: Special features that enable plants and animals to survive in a particular region are adaptations, such as conical shape and sloping branches in some mountain trees, long legs and wide hooves in hot desert camels, humps for food scarcity in camels, reduced water loss in camels, shorter height and smaller leaves in mountain rhododendrons, and streamlined bodies in fish. special_feature_in_specific_region -> survival_advantage -> adaptation The learner correctly applies this rule: Special features that enable plants and animals to survive in a particular region are adaptations, such as conical shape and sloping branches in some mountain trees, long legs and wide hooves in hot desert camels, humps for food scarcity in camels, reduced water loss in camels, shorter height and smaller leaves in mountain rhododendrons, and streamlined bod Adaptation means any noticeable body part, such as a hump or branch shape, even if it has no survival use in that region.
